headline: Doncic scores 53 as Lakers rally past Blazers

top.headline: Doncic scores 53 as Lakers rally past Blazers
top.summary: Luka Doncic scored a season-high 53 and the Lakers came back from a 60-53 halftime deficit to beat Portland 124-118. It's his fourth straight 40-point game, putting him with Kobe Bryant, Elgin Baylor and George Mikan as the only Lakers to do it. His 361 points through nine games trail only Wilt Chamberlain for that span.

top.headline: Porzingis steps away from basketball
top.summary: A day after Golden State started withholding his salary, Kristaps Porzingis said he is "stepping away" because his body can't perform at the level he expects. It isn't a formal retirement. Per ESPN, the Warriors can still use his salary in a trade before February's deadline, and Porzingis is open to a trade and possibly a buyout after.

top.headline: Ravens-Cardinals Jacoby Brissett trade is official
top.summary: The teams announced it Friday: Baltimore gets Brissett and a 2027 fifth for a 2027 fourth and a 2028 seventh, and Arizona pays more than half his remaining salary. With Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley on IR and four straight losses, Brissett is the Ravens' fourth starting QB in four weeks. He gets extra time before Monday night against the Chargers.

stories.headline: Myles Garrett set to return for Rams
stories.summary: Sean McVay confirmed Garrett will play Sunday against Washington after seven games on injured reserve following knee surgery. His snaps will be managed day by day.

stories.headline: Shedeur Sanders starts for Browns; Watson in concussion protocol
stories.summary: Todd Monken said Shedeur Sanders will start against New Orleans. Deshaun Watson is questionable and in the concussion protocol, and DT Maliek Collins (elbow) is out.

stories.headline: Jets rule out Garrett Wilson; Falcons lose Robinson for Madrid
stories.summary: WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) is out Sunday against Kansas City, though Breece Hall (quad) practiced fully. Atlanta ruled out RB Brian Robinson and WR Zachariah Branch (both hamstring) for the Cincinnati game in Madrid.

stories.headline: Shanahan 'couldn't care less' about Aiyuk meeting
stories.summary: Brandon Aiyuk and agent Drew Rosenhaus were set to meet 49ers officials Friday. Kyle Shanahan said the relationship has been "over for our football team for a long time." With the deadline Nov. 10, San Francisco has to keep, cut or trade him soon.

stories.headline: Ajay Mitchell's career night as Thunder rout Memphis
stories.summary: Mitchell scored a career-high 35 and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 28 in a 128-97 NBA Cup win. Oklahoma City turned 18 Grizzlies turnovers into 30 points while playing through injuries.

stories.headline: Cavs end Sixers' streak in LeBron's return; Spurs win seventh straight
stories.summary: Cleveland beat Philadelphia 119-95, snapping a five-game 76ers win streak in LeBron James' first trip back. San Antonio won 124-109 in Sacramento, and NBA.com says Victor Wembanyama's 250-point, 100-rebound, 35-block start through nine games is a record.

stories.headline: Short-handed Raptors come back on the Bucks
stories.summary: Without Barnes, Quickley, Bittle and Leonard, Toronto erased a nine-point halftime deficit and won 121-107. Alijah Martin and RJ Barrett scored 27 each. Milwaukee falls to 1-8.

leagues.name: NHL
leagues.summary: Gauthier caps a Ducks comeback in Calgary; Kaprizov's 16th leads the league; McDavid's streak goes on the line tonight

stories.headline: Gauthier finishes Ducks' comeback in Calgary
stories.summary: Down 3-0 after one, Anaheim won 5-3 on Cutter Gauthier's go-ahead goal with 1:34 left. Gauthier has 10 goals in a five-game goal streak. The Ducks have won four straight and scored at least five in seven straight.

stories.headline: Kaprizov's 16th leads the NHL as Wild beat Sharks
stories.summary: Kirill Kaprizov had a goal and three assists in a 4-1 win. Minnesota is 12-3-3 and 6-0-1 in its last seven; San Jose has lost four straight.

stories.headline: Sabres beat Blue Jackets; Monahan hurt
stories.summary: Josh Norris scored twice and Owen Power had three assists in Buffalo's 5-2 win, its fourth in five games. Columbus lost Sean Monahan to a lower-body injury late in the second.

stories.headline: McDavid's streak meets the reeling Canucks tonight
stories.summary: Connor McDavid has a point in all 17 games this season. One more against Vancouver, losers of 14 of 15, gives him the longest point streak by an active player.

standouts.name: Kirill Kaprizov
standouts.note: His power-play goal was his league-leading 16th.

standouts.name: Owen Power
standouts.note: Set up three as Buffalo scored five.

leagues.name: MLB
leagues.summary: Offseason · Crow-Armstrong, Bellinger win Platinum Gloves · Nats extend Jacob Young · Cardinals name Cerfolio GM

stories.headline: Crow-Armstrong, Bellinger win Platinum Gloves
stories.summary: Rawlings named the Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong the NL's top defender and the Yankees' Cody Bellinger the AL's, the first for each. Crow-Armstrong led MLB with +26 Outs Above Average.

stories.headline: Nationals extend CF Jacob Young: four years, $23M
stories.summary: The deal covers his arbitration years plus at least one free-agent year, with an $8 million club option. He's hit little (82 wRC+ since 2024), but Statcast rates him the second-best defensive outfielder of the past three seasons.

stories.headline: Cardinals promote Rob Cerfolio to GM
stories.summary: The 34-year-old assistant GM becomes the No. 2 under Chaim Bloom. He fills the opening left when Randy Flores became the Astros' GM.
